thread:
Alex Chen: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we need a concrete plan for INT8/FP8/INT4 attention dequant fusion. Two things: (1) kernel API boundaries so ops can opt into fusion safely, (2) runtime safety profiles to gate fusion per workload.

Priya Rao: Agreed. Main failure mode we saw in experiments is numerical drift with long KV cache. Fusion hides intermediate rounding so diffs increase over sequence length.

Jon Martínez: I can add a per-layer 'fusion_safety_score' output from the profiler. Heuristic: if relative error (fp32 baseline vs fused) > 2e-3 over validation prompt set -> disable fusion for that layer. Keep it cheap.

Melisa Park: Also need a clear hardware path: some GPUs (A100/4th gen) have FP8-friendly tensor ops, others don't. We should expose kernel flags like `supports_fp8_block` and `requires_dequant_staging` so dispatcher can pick correct impl.

Alex Chen: Proposal for kernel registration API (draft):

```
register_kernel("attn_qkv_dequant_fused", {
  inputs: ["q","k","v","scale_q","scale_k","bias?"],
  outputs: ["out"],
  flags: ["supports_partial_kv_cache","fp8_block","accumulates_in_fp32"],
  quant_profiles: ["INT8_S2","FP8_E4M3","INT4_A2"],
  safety_checks: ["max_rel_error","max_bias_shift"]
})
```

Priya Rao: Love it. Add `fallback_kernel` pointer and `disable_on_sequence_length` so runtime can disable fusion past X tokens.

Jon Martínez: For the safety profile, I propose three modes: `aggressive` (max perf, fusion whenever possible), `balanced` (default: fusion if profiler score < 1e-3), `conservative` (only use fusion if validated on customer prompt sets). We can let customers pick via model config + rollout policy.

Melisa Park: Operationally we need metrics: per-request numeric_delta, rollout_error_rate (tokens with > threshold), perf_delta (latency/tokens). Add these to Console and to per-route tracing.

Alex Chen: Good. Also discussion on dequant fusion layout: do we fuse dequant+matmul+softmax or stop at dequant+matmul and keep softmax separate? Fusing softmax complicates stable softmax numerics when values are large.

Priya Rao: My tests show dequant+matmul fusion is safe with fp8->fp32 accumulation, but fusing softmax gives occasional nan under extreme keys. I'd avoid softmax fusion until we have better range tracking.

Jon Martínez: Implementation detail: the kernel should declare whether it `preserves_kv_cache_layout`. If it doesn't, the runtime needs to materialize dequantized KV into cache — that kills perf for long cache. So prefer kernels that preserve layout.

Melisa Park: For rollout: canary 5% of traffic using `balanced` profile for top 10 customers by usage. Monitor model MRR/qa metrics and ensure regression < 0.5% on quality evals. Auto rollback if `numeric_delta` spike or customer E2E eval drops.

Alex Chen: Who owns the kernel registry change? Jon? It needs tests: unit FP comparison, long-cache integration, and nightly cross-hardware correctness matrix.

Jon Martínez: I'll own registry and a driver that picks by flags. I'll add tests: `compare_baseline()` harness that runs 100 short+10 long sequences across A100/H100 and collects `rms_error`, `max_abs_diff`.

Priya Rao: I'll build the profiler heuristic and hook it into model onboarding. Also will add prompt-set validation runner so customers can opt-in to validate fusion on their private prompts (for Private/Dedicated).

Melisa Park: Ops: add `dequant_fusion_rate` and `avg_numeric_delta` to the rollout dashboard. Also a kernel label in traces so we can slice latency by impl.

runtime-bot: deploybot: Canary started for `attn_qkv_dequant_fused` on cluster `dedicated-us-west-2` (5% traffic). Link: https://deploys.internal/release/1225

Priya Rao: Reminder — document migration path for older models: default to `conservative` for pinned older checkpoints, let new versions opt into `balanced`.

Alex Chen: Action items: Jon - kernel registry + tests; Priya - profiler heuristic + prompt validation runner; Mel - dashboard metrics + trace labels. We'll reconvene after first canary (monitor window 6h).

Jon Martínez: I'll push the initial registry PR by EOD.

Melisa Park: I’ll add Grafana panels and alerts (numeric_delta > 1e-3 triggers pager).

Priya Rao: Noted. I'll also add docs for customers: `model.config.quant_fusion_profile = "balanced" | "conservative" | "aggressive"`.

Alex Chen: Cool. If nobody objects, we'll proceed with this plan. :thumbsup:

Jon Martínez: No objections from me.

Melisa Park: Good to go.

Priya Rao: Go ahead.

runtime-bot: observability: Canary metrics: perf +3.8% latency improvement, avg_numeric_delta 6.2e-4, no spikes in E2E tests within first 2h.

Alex Chen: Great first signal. Keep monitoring and produce a short summary thread in 12h.
